items.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Could Be 29% Undervalued Following Its KFC Deal Renewal
items.summary: PepsiCo (PEP) just renewed its beverage supply deal with KFC across eight international markets, extending a decades long partnership and keeping its drink portfolio embedded in one of the largest global fast food chains. PepsiCo shares have picked up speed recently, with a 30 day share price return of 13.52% and a 7 day move of 6.67% at a last close of US$142.71. This comes even though the 3 year total shareholder return declined 4.29% and the 5 year total shareholder return was 3.16%...
